confirm.title: Open it?
confirm.warning: Everything you hold will be lost: pages, methods, Knowledge, intuitions. +{n} Ether.

opening.title: The opening
text:
What happened?
I opened the book.
The floor gave way.

When I open my eyes again,
its pages are waiting for me.
At last, I can read it.

Around me, nothing left.
It has fed on everything.

start.name: Head start
start.description: When I wake, I already know how to skim.

memory.name: Memory of methods
memory.description: These sentences, the book no longer devours.
